why_this_queue_exists: The engineering agent has NO network. Anything needing bytes from outside this checkout is the research agent's. Marking a task blocked on something outside the repository WITHOUT writing the request here is the error that has already cost this project real work twice: blocked means blocked for BOTH agents. If it is only blocked for one, it is not blocked, it is assigned.

items.title: Reconcile the 2024 team-vs-opponent definitional gap
items.detail: The packet reports +0.1201 for 2024. Re-derived from repo bytes with the repo's own verified DK adapter, four variants span +0.147 to +0.158 and none reproduces +0.1201. 2025 reproduces (+0.2068 vs +0.2034). The gap is most likely which players count as offense. Name the definition.

items.title: Club game-release PDFs for one 2023 regular-season game
items.detail: Raw bytes, source URL, retrieval time. Do NOT infer publication time from document content. If publication or capture evidence is unavailable, leave it NULL.

items.title: Archived HRRR forecast run for the same game
items.detail: An as-issued FORECAST file whose initialization precedes the cut and whose lead reaches kickoff. Temperature, sustained wind, gust, precipitation. Raw GRIB provenance and hashes. NOT analysis, NOT observation, NOT reanalysis, NOT stitched historical weather.
items.constraint: Model initialization alone does NOT establish PIT admission. Return what evidence exists for publication or availability latency.
